note.en: Rack-scale product with very limited on-demand access: only three configs are confirmed in stock this cycle — CoreWeave still lists the cheapest published rate (~$10.50/GPU-hr, re-confirmed), Oracle Cloud bare-metal is now the best-corroborated mid-point at ~$16.00/GPU-hr (down from a blended ~$18.79 estimate that could no longer be independently confirmed), and Azure's ND GB200 v6 bare-metal listing remains the ceiling at ~$27/GPU-hr. AWS now publishes a 1-year reserved rate of $10.58/GPU-hr — the first contract figure seen for this SKU. Most other capacity (Together AI, CoreWeave) is still sold as quote-only reserved terms.

Floor holds at Packet.ai's ~$3.75/GPU-hr, re-confirmed today as GetDeploying's cheapest verified in-stock rate. Typical price eased to ~$6.13/GPU-hr (GetDeploying's tracked median across 16 priced configs as of Sept 6, down from ~$6.50 last cycle) as more Blackwell capacity comes online at Spheron (~$3.70) and Lambda (~$4.99); AWS p6 now lists ~$14.24/GPU-hr, still under Google Cloud's a4-highgpu-8g ceiling of $16.11/GPU-hr. No clean published 1-year rate.

Reclassified the floor: Vultr's own preemptible-instances announcement and Spheron's pricing breakdown both confirm today that Vultr's ~$2.59/GPU-hr rate is a preemptible/spot SKU, not on-demand ('preemptible instances give customers... even lower cost' than Vultr's own on-demand line) — so it no longer qualifies as the on-demand floor. True on-demand pricing clusters at OVHcloud/Vultr on-demand ~$7.10/GPU-hr and CoreWeave ~$7.20/GPU-hr, with Oracle bare-metal still the ceiling at $8.60/GPU-hr (the only rate Spheron calls 'verified true on-demand'). CoreWeave's $4.25/GPU-hr 1-year reservation remains the only published contract rate for this SKU. Coverage is still thin (4 tracked providers); watch for a first-party Vultr on-demand rate card to pin this down further.

sources.label: Vultr blog — AMD Instinct GPU preemptible instances

note.en: Min from FluidStack ($2.30, re-confirmed today). Typical price eased slightly to ~$4.30/GPU-hr as GMI Cloud ($2.60) and Jarvislabs ($3.99 on-demand, $1.99 spot) undercut the prior ~$4.47 cluster; Vast.ai marketplace and RunPod still sit at $3.82-4.39. Hyperscaler ceiling reconfirmed via Vantage/CloudPrice at Azure's ND96isr H200 v5, $110.24/hr for 8 GPUs = $13.78/GPU-hr — no reserved SKU exists for that instance. Reserved-rate listings still average ~$3.72/GPU-hr.

sources.label: Vantage — Azure ND96isr H200 v5 instance pricing

note.en: Widest rental market (54+ providers): the $1.49/GPU-hr Vast.ai floor has now dropped out of GetDeploying's verified-in-stock tracker for a second consecutive check (Sept 4 and Sept 6), which instead reads $1.73/GPU-hr as the cheapest confirmed in-stock on-demand rate — treating this as the new floor (+16% vs the old figure). Typical price is essentially flat at ~$3.32/GPU-hr (GetDeploying's 40-provider median), with budget PCIe capacity (Vultr ~$2.99, Hyperbolic ~$3.19, Thunder Compute ~$3.20, Lambda ~$3.29) clustering just below it. Hyperscaler ceiling reconfirmed via Vantage at Azure's ND96isr H100 v5, $98.32/hr ÷ 8 GPUs = $12.29/GPU-hr, still above AWS (~$6.88) and Google Cloud (~$10.98) list prices. Per SemiAnalysis, 1-year contract rates were around $2.35/GPU-hr as of spring 2026 (not reconfirmed this cycle); Lambda Labs' 1-year reserved SXM rate (est. $5.54-6.16/GPU-hr for 1-Click Clusters off a higher on-demand base) is a different product tier and not directly comparable, so the SemiAnalysis figure carries over pending a cleaner like-for-like contract quote.

sources.label: Vantage — Azure ND96isr H100 v5 instance pricing

note.en: Aggressively priced for its 192GB of HBM3: TensorWave still anchors the low end at ~$1.71/GPU-hr (re-confirmed today, though it's a sales-quote rate with no self-serve checkout), while Azure's ND96isr MI300X v5 list price re-confirmed on cloudprice.net spans $6.00/GPU-hr in its cheapest regions (East US 2, West US 3) up to $12.00/GPU-hr in its priciest (Brazil South). Typical pricing stays ~$3.20/GPU-hr, with RunPod (~$2.39) and DigitalOcean (~$2.59) undercutting the hyperscaler premium. DigitalOcean's 12-month reserved rate holds at $1.91/GPU-hr; Cyfuture AI now shows a cheaper 12-month reserved listing at ~$1.62/GPU-hr on GetDeploying's tracker.

Legacy workhorse in steady decline: floor dropped sharply as Vast.ai's marketplace now undercuts the field at ~$0.53/GPU-hr (confirmed range $0.39-0.67 depending on host reliability), well below Thunder Compute's prior $1.09/GPU-hr anchor. GetDeploying's tracked median holds at ~$1.76-1.80/GPU-hr, with GCP a2-ultragpu still listing ~$5.07/GPU-hr at the top. Civo's tiered 80GB rate card is unaffected — $1.79 on-demand, $1.59 at 12 months, down to $1.39 at 36 months; most other contract demand has moved to H100/H200.

sources.label: Civo — NVIDIA A100 GPU cloud pricing

note.en: Min holds at Lium.io's ~$0.38/GPU-hr (Des Moines); budget marketplaces (Salad, Vast.ai, Novita) cluster at $0.32-0.68. Typical pricing has firmed up further to ~$1.13/GPU-hr (median across 42 priced configs per a fresh GetDeploying-based read), continuing the upward drift from the prior ~$1.05 estimate. Ceiling holds near $3.5-3.8/GPU-hr (AWS us-east-1 8x config, re-confirmed at $3.77). Civo's rate card is unchanged and re-confirmed: $1.29 on-demand, $0.89 at 12 months, $0.89 at 36 months.

sources.label: Civo — NVIDIA L40S GPU cloud pricing

note.en: Consumer flagship on marketplaces only (no hyperscaler offering): Salad Cloud still floors the market at ~$0.25/GPU-hr, unchanged since launch. The published ceiling shifted: Beam's serverless rate ($1.09/GPU-hr, confirmed on Beam's own pricing page) now edges out RunPod's Secure Cloud tier ($0.99/GPU-hr, still current) as the priciest widely-published on-demand option. Median holds near ~$0.64/GPU-hr, roughly flat versus the prior read.

Vast.ai's marketplace floor is holding near ~$0.13-0.14/GPU-hr — marketplace pricing is volatile and hour-to-hour reads vary. Serverless-billed providers keep the ceiling near $1.61/GPU-hr (Beam, re-confirmed by AIMultiple); trackers that exclude serverless configs read a lower ~$0.74-0.77 top, so the ceiling carries over pending a closer look. Typical pricing has eased slightly to ~$0.42/GPU-hr — down about 13% over the trailing 90 days per a fresh GetDeploying-based read (Sept 2), continuing a slow downward drift as Theta EdgeCloud, GPU.ai and Novita add cheap capacity. Novita's 12-month reserved rate of $0.27/GPU-hr remains the only contract figure tracked for this SKU.
